what: Swiper creative tilts and overlaps the photo slides. deck (default) stacks them in place with the next slide at +4° and the previous at −4°, rests 3.2s, then switches in .8s. The current slide’s photo fades out after 3.6s over .8s so the next one beneath shows first. peek tilts the center slide 2° and offsets the side slides 104%·∓16% at .8x so they show on both sides, advancing every 4s (below 768 it stays in place at ∓2°). Sends fx:change (slide number) on every change

options.x: peek side Section horizontal offset (%), default 104
options.y: peek: vertical offset of the side sheet (%), default 16
options.scale: Side card size for peek, default .8
options.wide: Width (px) at which peek unfolds sideways, default 768
options.start: If event, holds until fx:start is received (starts behind the opening curtain)
options.--fx-fade-at: deck: when the current Section’s photo starts to disappear, default 3.6s
options.--fx-first-at: The moment for only the first section started with fx:start, default --fx-fade-at
options.--fx-dur: peek center slide tilt · hover duration, default .4s
